narrative:
## Handover Summary — Revenue Planning

Revenue targets validated across all business segments and entities. Agent proposals reviewed and accepted or overridden by planners.

## Key Decisions
• Entertainment & Events plan re-phased towards its forecast run-rate (EUR -12.0M)
• Merchandise upside of EUR 34.0M kept in the forecast, not yet in targets

## Recommendation for COGS Phase
Model Operations Cast Labour against the updated volume trajectory first — it is 64% of COGS.

signals.title: Resort Hotels RevPAR EUR 3.3 below forecast — occupancy, not ADR
signals.source: SDP Hotel Revenue — 7 hotels, occupancy × ADR, booking-curve pace
signals.excerpt: October 2026 RevPAR was EUR 325.6 against EUR 328.9 forecast. ADR held at EUR 369 (+EUR 6 vs forecast), but occupancy was 88.2% against 90.5%: Davy Crockett Ranch (−EUR 16.6 RevPAR) and Hotel Santa Fe (−EUR 15.0) ran 6–7 points behind on weaker UK package pickup.
